correctness.rationale: For GP(8,3), independently enumerated all 6812 nonempty Ind_2 faces from induced-degree condition, tested 35104 oriented Hasse incidences for acyclicity and recovered one critical vertex, a 4-cell, four 5-cells and six 6-cells. Independently computed exact Morse Smith factors d5=(1), d6=(1,1,1,0), with composition zero; cellular cancellations yield 3 S^6. Independent graph automorphism enumeration gives 96 actions; fixed-face Lefschetz computation gives trace counts {-3:2,-1:30,0:32,1:30,3:2}, norm square 96, trace sum zero and exactly two trace-3 elements. These prove absolutely irreducible 3-dimensional rational action, kernel of size two and rationally acyclic quotient.
